title: 3D Wind Rose: A browser-based climate data and building context viewer
description: An interactive 3D wind rose drawn over a live map, built for teaching architecture students. Wind data from an uploaded EPW file, or one of three built-in UK locations, is binned into a 16-direction frequency table with five speed bands, by month or for the whole year, and drawn at the site beside a default footprint or a building imported as an .obj model. It runs in the browser; three.js and MapLibre GL JS load from a CDN, and the basemap and location search come from MapTiler.
